answer_1.quote: According to the introduction in Section 2.1, we assume that the model M used for inference should accomplish two tasks: (1) generating next subquestions and (2) answering the sub-questions.

answer_2.quote: Following Wei et al. ( ), we use accuracy (acc) as the evaluation metric, which measures whether the ground-truth answers are included in the model generations.
